# Holy Priest — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 14/37/0 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 102 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (2 members), level 48 (3 members), level 51 (1 member), level 60 (8 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/priest/holy/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD healer** — 65 → 204 HPS; HoT ticks invisible, so floor [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [holy.md](./holy.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **39 — Renew** (`H09w-renew-weave-self`) — level 60+ · intent `filler` · target `self` · spell 139
  - **When:** in combat; the lowest party health at least 70%; the resident is not moving; at least 30 mana; mana at least 30%; time since the resident cast Flash Heal is less than 3500 ms; time since the resident cast Flash Heal (ms) below time since the resident cast Renew (ms).
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-220 (Book of Prayer 2/2 is in the build): "cast Renew R1 on someone who needs it (or on yourself) so your next heal is a different spell and Book of Prayer refunds mana.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **H00u-mana-oil — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 229); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **H00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 24363 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 233); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **H00u-demonic-rune — Use Demonic Rune:** HO-TKB-PLAY-206 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18; ruling: a rule naming an item nobody holds is free): Demonic Rune (item 12662).
- **H00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **H00u-herbal-salad — Use Empowering Herbal Salad:** HO-TKB-PLAY-344 (consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can buy gets a use rule so the kit generator carries it from level_min): Empowering Herbal Salad (item 83309, required level 45, vendor 5000 copper, DB tkbplay-344.result.txt); priest/holy.md L234: "Empowering Herbal Salad gives +24 healing" (aura 49553, Increased Healing Bonus). Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 49553 missing (so again after a death).
- **H00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** Used in a fight against a boss (the shape of PR00u-juju-flurry): in combat, a hostile boss target, item held and ready, aura 16322 missing.
- **H00h-prepull-renew — Renew:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Renew on the tank before a boss pull (`target: tank`). Priority 1: a boss pull outranks a drink in progress.
- **H00f-fear-ward-tank-boss — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss). Every boss pull, because no field says which bosses fear: 100 mana and a 30 s cooldown for a 10 minute ward.
- **H00f2-fear-ward-tank-pull — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss). Every boss pull, because no field says which bosses fear: 100 mana and a 30 s cooldown for a 10 minute ward.
- **H02l-lightwell-before-the-pull — Lightwell:** 12 per cent of base mana, 300 s cooldown, 1.5 s cast (not while moving), so one cast per five minutes at the first imminent pull; mana at 60 per cent or more like the Fear Ward pull rule.
- **H13-resurrection — Resurrection:** `mana_pct >= 30`, not 75, is new, and the unit is the whole reason it is not 75: `manaCostPercentage` is a share of BASE mana (Spell::CalculatePowerCost) while `mana_pct` binds to the CURRENT pool (`state-vocabulary.yaml`), and this file's own H12-dispel-magic already measured the gap between the two - 18 per cent of base cost exactly 85 mana off a 1190-point bar, so base is about 472, which is the "480" this file's own mana-curve section states and derives its 2.48 pool-to-base ratio from. `mana_pct >= 30` is that conversion, not a re-use of the cleanses' unrelated flat 30 per cent reserve (H10-H12, whose own costs are 15-18 per cent of base and would convert to about 6-7 per cent of pool - their 30 is a floor, not a conversion).
- **H01-fortitude — Power Word: Fortitude:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. So `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health, never about whoever is missing the buff, and a member that loses it waits for its own health to make it the selection.
- **H02-inner-fire — Inner Fire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **H02b-divine-spirit — Divine Spirit:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. ONE MEMBER PER TICK, NOT THE PARTY (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001, OQ-2811): Tick.cpp picks exactly one healTarget - the lowest-health living member, or the tank while it holds hostiles under Bots.HealTankFirstPct, or the resident under Bots.HealSelfFloorPct - and Party.cpp aims buffs at that same one unit, so `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health and never about whoever is missing the buff.
- **H02e-enlighten-self — Enlighten:** Cast on yourself it adds spell damage and healing for its duration (DB 51476: dummy aura, 60 s cooldown, no mana).
- **H03-shield — Power Word: Shield:** Weakened Soul (6788) blocks a second shield for 15 s and the spell carries a 4 s categoryRecoveryTime of its own, so both gates are here: the aura test for the debuff the core applies and cooldown_ready for the category.
- **H03s-shield-self-pressed — Power Word: Shield:** H03-shield (30) shields the HEAL target under 30 per cent, so a healer that is the one being hit never got a shield (round 108, 5 deaths of a priest in a party: no shield aura in the 15 s before any).
- **H02d-ascendance — Ascendance:** The guide: for 30 s heals cost about a third less and cast about a fifth faster, targets gain +15 per cent healing taken, it also breaks CC; "press it just before a boss enrages" and "Save Ascendance for enrage and burst windows" (holy.md L3, L46, L149). THE PROXY IS OURS: the rotation vocabulary has no enrage timer and cannot read a boss's phase from a healer's heal-target view (target.boss is the hostile target), so 'burst' is read from the party's health, which spends the cooldown during damage and not before it; the enrage timing is proposed as an open question.
- **H03b-inner-focus-prayer — Inner Focus:** Inner Focus is 180 s, 0 mana, aura 108 -101 per cent mana cost on the next spell (tkbplay-220.result.txt).
- **H03a-inner-focus — Inner Focus:** The first use, spending it on a specific max-rank spell, needs a way to bind a buff to the next cast that the rule format has not got.
- **H09w-renew-weave-self — Renew:** So the weave is a rank-1 Renew (30 mana) on the priest herself, ONLY when nobody in the party is under 70 per cent (so it costs no needed heal and never competes with H09/H09b/H04b), and only right after a Flash Heal (cast within 3.5 s) that is more recent than the last Renew (so Renew is never cast twice in a row, which would not refund).
- **H00g-fear-ward-tank-feared — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, p4-dungeon's mechanics audit: the fear bosses Dragonmaw Halgan, Stormwrought Balor and Halthas): Fear Ward on the tank in the fight once anyone is feared (party.any_feared), so the boss's next fear misses the tank ("Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses", priest/leveling.md L153). The ward does not break a fear already on the tank; it lasts 10 minutes or one fear, 30 s cooldown, 100 mana; `not aura_target(6346)` keeps a second priest from re-warding.
- **H07t-heal-tank-heavy — Heal:** HO-TKB-PLAY-151 (orchestrator, the owner's SFK priority: round 134's leveller wipes began with the healer at a median 4 per cent mana but the wiping fights opened at a median 100, so they drained a full healer; in those fights the healer's tank heals were Lesser Heal 49, Renew 35, Heal 21, docs/research/tkb/play/sfk-class-forensics.py): "Tank low (about half health): Max-rank Lesser Heal (R3), or Heal R1 from 16 when damage is heavy"; "the big heal kept ready for bosses and 3+ mob pulls" (priest/leveling.md L125-L126).
- **H09-renew — Renew:** Stops at "not present" because v2 cannot see how long an aura has left (OQ-1402). `not aura_target(139)` is also the only per-target "I healed this one a moment ago" guard the vocabulary has, and it is why Renew needs no other repeat guard while the direct heals below it do (OQ-2517).
- **H09b-renew-topup — Renew:** `not aura_target(139)` is the same per-target repeat guard H09 carries and the only one the vocabulary offers (OQ-2517), so this rule cannot re-lay a Renew that is already ticking on the same chosen target. The mana guard is two-part and both halves are load-bearing: `mana_pct >= 30`, at least as strict as the reserve this file's three cleanses already carry (H10/H11/H12, OQ-2803, OQ-2519), because this is the lowest-urgency heal in the file (everyone is at or above 70) and must not be the cast that empties the bar; and `mana >= 30`, Renew's own rank-1 cost and the same absolute floor H09-renew uses (spell_template 139, manaCost 30 at rank 1, 105 at rank 3 - H09's own cite).
- **H12m-dispel-magic-must — Dispel Magic:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **H10m-abolish-disease-must — Abolish Disease:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **H05-prayer-of-healing — Prayer of Healing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **H07-heal — Heal:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **H08-lesser-heal — Lesser Heal:** Choosing the rank rather than the spell is what the archive actually asks for ("Downrank when under ~50% mana: Heal R2+, Greater Heal R1+, Renew R3+ keep full scaling") and the rule format cannot say it: there is no rank field and the engine casts the highest rank known (OQ-2511). HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **H10-abolish-disease — Abolish Disease:** NOT free at the pin, which this note said until HO-TKB-PLAY-003 and the whole file said with it. manaCost is 0 and manaCostPercentage is 15, and Spell::CalculatePowerCost adds ManaCostPercentage * caster->GetCreateMana() / 100 to the cost, so the cleanse costs 15 per cent of base mana at every level. It removes a disease every 5 s for 20 s, so it outranks the single-shot cure from 32.
- **H11-cure-disease — Cure Disease:** The single-shot cure, manaCost 0 but manaCostPercentage 15 (see H10-abolish-disease); live from 14 and left in place above 32 because H10 outranks it and the loop takes the first true rule. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **H12-dispel-magic — Dispel Magic:** DispelType 1 is magic; target.dispellable(k) is true only for a type this priest's dispel would actually remove, so the rule cannot burn a global on an undispellable aura - but it can burn 85 mana on a dispellable one that did not matter, and which debuffs are worth that is OQ-2519. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **H13m-shackle-undead-moon — Shackle Undead:** HO-TKB-PLAY-120 (owner-approved, TortoiseBots review LEARN 1: crowd control on the party's CC mark): Shackle Undead on the Moon-marked mob when it is undead (targetCreatureType 32, `target.creature_type(6)`); 90 mana at rank 1, 1.5 s, 30 yd; ranks 9484, 9485, 10955; it breaks on damage like Polymorph. The guide: "Shackle Undead on an extra undead mob" in the dungeon list (guide/classes/priest/leveling.md L153, L188).
- **H13a-shackle-undead-second — Shackle Undead:** HO-TKB-PLAY-038 (orchestrator; p1-loop v12 answers OQ-2817): Shackle Undead (9484, level 20, 90 mana, 1.5 s, 30 yd) on the OTHER attacker when it is UNDEAD (the spell''s targetCreatureType mask 32 = undead; `target.creature_type(6)`). The guide lists it among the priest''s undead extras and, in the level 20-29 notes, before fearing bosses.
- **H14-psychic-scream — Psychic Scream:** The panic button: 100 mana, 30 s categoryRecoveryTime, 8 s of fear inside 8 yd. Gated on the healer already being hurt because a feared pack runs out of the tank's reach.
- **H17e-shadow-word-pain-elite-solo — Shadow Word: Pain:** HO-TKB-PLAY-290 (leveller pass): from 30 the pain is kept for elites and bosses: "Skip Shadow Word: Pain on normal mobs, because most die before 3 ticks. Keep it for elites and bosses" (priest/leveling.md L166, L278), and "Elites or multiple mobs: buff -> Power Word: Shield -> Holy Fire -> Shadow Word: Pain -> wand" (L281).
- **H17-shadow-word-pain — Shadow Word: Pain:** HO-TKB-PLAY-290 (leveller pass): from level 30 the pain on a normal mob is cast only while moving (Smite cannot be cast then); elites and bosses get H17e below: "Skip Shadow Word: Pain on normal mobs, because most die before 3 ticks. Keep it for elites and bosses, and cast it while moving" (priest/leveling.md L166, L278); "Dotting every mob after 30" is listed as a common mistake (L346).
- **H18a-smite-solo — Smite:** H16-holy-fire and H18-smite were removed because `party.members_below(100) == 0` cannot tell a full-health party from none; `not (party.lowest_hp_pct >= 0)` is the solo test the rogues' Stealth rule already uses (no party member read), so a priest alone attacks and a priest in a party does not spend its heal budget.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **H02l-lightwell-before-the-pull:** The burst-phase use of L151 and the guide placement where the raid stacks (the priest, not the tank, is the anchor) are open question 1 of the handoff.
- **H03m-shield-self-solo-two-mobs:** The guide gives no health figure for a mob that hits hard; that is open question 1 of the handoff.
- **H02d-ascendance:** THE PROXY IS OURS: the rotation vocabulary has no enrage timer and cannot read a boss's phase from a healer's heal-target view (target.boss is the hostile target), so 'burst' is read from the party's health, which spends the cooldown during damage and not before it; the enrage timing is proposed as an open question.
- **H09b-renew-topup:** Above 80 per cent mana the top-up still fires, so a calm fight changes nothing; below it the band is left to H09-renew (under 70) and the heals above it (docs/research/tkb/play/r18-healer-mana.txt).
- **H16p-holy-fire-purifying-flames-solo:** Longer fights: not (target.ttd_ms < 8000), the shape the shadow rule S09f uses; the guide gives no figure (open question 2 of the handoff).
- **H19-shoot:** `Bots.HealerNoWandInDungeon` is a runtime gate this rule's own `when` cannot see or predicate against: OQ-2781 (p4-group2, owner p1-loop) is binding a `self.in_dungeon` snapshot field for exactly this, and OQ-2782 (this workstream's own open question) is the rotation half - "once `self.in_dungeon` exists, the guard is one clause (`not self.in_dungeon`) on the wand rules of the healer books" - and states plainly it cannot be written before that binding lands.
